units.macro_false_alarms_per10000_negatives: mean false alarms per10000 target-negative events

limitations: Additional labeled calibration events are supervision beyond the one enrolled image, even without natural-image gradient training.
Results are conditional on chosen references, trained checkpoints, CALIB recipe/cutoffs and the observed cohort.
Event-time grouping handles known dependence but does not prove independent physical events.
Positive-presence rejection conditions the bootstrap; sparse target classes still give unstable intervals.
Intervals are pointwise percentile intervals, not familywise multiplicity-adjusted.
FP per10,000 is normalized from observed negative counts, not a claim of10,000 independent negatives.
No trained arm or ablation will be promoted after viewing TEST.
